247ithelp.com (ConnectWise).Description: ConnectWise RMM is a unified remote monitoring and management solution that enables IT professionals to monitor client endpoints in real-time, automate patching, and manage SaaS workloads and networks. Barracuda.Description: Barracuda RMM, formerly Managed Workplace, is a remote monitoring and management tool focused on security-centric IT management. It includes patch management, site security assessments, and integration with other Barracuda security products.

BeamYourScreen.Description: BeamYourScreen was a screen sharing and web conferencing tool used for online meetings, remote support, and training. It has since been rebranded as Mikogo.

Bluetrait.Description: Bluetrait is a remote administration tool used by MSPs for monitoring, support, and managing endpoints. It is designed for small and medium IT service providers.

CentraStage (Now Datto).Description: CentraStage was a cloud-based RMM platform for MSPs and IT teams. It was acquired and rebranded by Datto into Datto RMM.

Centurion.Description: Centurion is a remote monitoring and management solution designed to provide secure remote access, diagnostics, and automated maintenance. It is typically used in industrial and secure environments.

CrossTec Remote Control.Description: CrossTec Remote Control provides secure remote access, support, and monitoring for enterprise environments. It supports multiple OS platforms and includes remote control, screen recording, and system management tools.

DameWare.Description: DameWare is a suite of remote administration tools by SolarWinds used for managing and supporting systems. It includes Mini Remote Control, Remote Support, and integration with Active Directory.

KHelpDesk.Description: KHelpDesk is a help desk and remote support software designed for IT support teams. It integrates ticketing, remote access, and reporting in one interface for streamlined support workflows.

Kaseya (VSA).Description: Kaseya VSA is an RMM and endpoint management platform providing automation, monitoring, patching, and security tools. It is designed to support large-scale IT operations and MSPs.

KickIdler.Description: KickIdler is an employee monitoring and remote access software. It provides real-time screen viewing, activity reports, and remote control functionality.

LANDesk.Description: LANDesk (now part of Ivanti) was a systems management platform offering software deployment, asset management, patching, and remote support for enterprise networks.

MSP360.Description: MSP360 (formerly CloudBerry Lab) provides backup, disaster recovery, and RMM tools tailored to managed service providers. Its RMM suite includes patching, monitoring, scripting, and remote desktop capabilities.

MyIVO.Description: MyIVO is a remote IT support platform designed for managed service providers. It offers monitoring, alerts, remote access, and script-based automation for endpoint management.

NateOn-desktop sharing.Description: NateOn is a South Korean instant messaging service that includes desktop sharing and remote control features for collaboration and support.

Pulseway.Description: Pulseway is a mobile-first RMM platform that allows IT administrators to monitor and manage systems from any device. It offers automation, remote control, patching, and reporting tools, suitable for both MSPs and internal IT teams.

SunLogin.Description: SunLogin is a remote desktop tool developed by Chinese vendor SunTech. It offers remote access, file transfers, and secure connections for personal and enterprise use.

ZeroTier.Description: ZeroTier is a secure, open-source virtual networking solution that creates encrypted peer-to-peer networks. It’s used to enable remote access, network segmentation, and hybrid cloud infrastructure management.

Zoho Assist.Description: Zoho Assist is a cloud-based remote support and remote access software for IT support teams. It supports unattended access, file transfers, multi-monitor navigation, and integration with Zoho products.

eHorus.Description: eHorus is a remote desktop tool developed by Pandora FMS. It offers cloud-based remote access, session management, and monitoring features tailored for MSPs and IT support teams.

ezHelp.Description: ezHelp is a remote support tool that enables technicians to assist users with desktop sharing, remote control, and live troubleshooting over the internet.

mRemoteNG.Description: mRemoteNG is an open-source, multi-protocol remote connections manager that supports RDP, VNC, SSH, Telnet, and more. It is used for managing remote connections in a single, unified interface.

ngrok.Description: ngrok is a tunneling tool that exposes local servers to the internet through secure tunnels. It is widely used for testing webhooks, APIs, and demos without modifying firewall rules.

rdp2tcp.Description: rdp2tcp is a tunneling tool that forwards TCP connections via RDP. It enables network pivoting and secure communication for penetration testing and remote administration.

rdpwrap.Description: RDP Wrapper is a tool that enables multiple RDP sessions on Windows systems without modifying system files. It allows concurrent remote desktop access on Windows editions that don’t support it natively.
